claims.text: GPT-5.6 Sol Standard on OpenAI's own API is $5.00/$30.00 per million tokens.
claims.citation: OpenAI API pricing page (https://platform.openai.com/docs/pricing) and model catalog list gpt-5.6-sol Standard at $5.00 in / $30.00 out, cached input $0.50.

claims.text: GPT-5.6 Sol is listed at $2.50/$15 (50% off) on OpenRouter's OpenAI provider endpoint.
claims.citation: OpenRouter model page shows OpenAI provider at $2.50/$15 with '50% off' badge; OpenRouter /api/v1/models lists prompt 0.0000025, completion 0.000015, discount 0.5.

claims.text: GPT-5.6 Sol is listed at $2.50/$15 standard on Vercel's AI Gateway.
claims.citation: Vercel AI Gateway public models API (https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/v1/models) returns openai/gpt-5.6-sol input 0.0000025, output 0.000015.

claims.text: Azure/Bedrock providers serving Sol through OpenRouter still list $5.00-$5.50 / $30-$33 (no 50% discount).
claims.citation: OpenRouter provider table and endpoints API: Azure $5.00/$30, Azure EU/US $5.50/$33, Bedrock US $5.50/$33, discount 0.

claims.text: On July 30, 2026 OpenAI cut Luna 80% and Terra 20% on its own API while leaving Sol Standard at $5/$30.
claims.citation: OpenAI changelog Jul 30 entry and VentureBeat's 'AI price wars' story both state Luna -80%, Terra -20%, Sol Standard unchanged.

claims.text: Altman announced the July 30 cuts on X as 'major price cuts today'.
claims.citation: VentureBeat quotes Sam Altman announcing 'major price cuts today' on X, in the context of the Luna/Terra reductions.

claims.text: OpenRouter's OpenAI Flex endpoint for Sol is $1.25/$7.50, 50% below the API Flex price of $2.50/$15.
claims.citation: OpenRouter endpoints API shows openai/flex tag at prompt 0.00000125 / completion 0.0000075; OpenAI pricing page shows Flex $2.50/$15.

claims.text: OpenRouter weekly token rankings (Aug 18, 2026) show DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 #1 at 11.3T tokens and six of the top ten slots held by Chinese labs.
claims.citation: OpenRouter rankings page (https://openrouter.ai/rankings): DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 11.3T, Hy3 9.7T, Luna 5.57T, MiMo-V2.5 4.99T, DeepSeek V4 Flash 0423 4.77T, GLM 5.2 4.41T, Gemini 3.6 Flash 2.77T, Opus 5 2.7T, DeepSeek V4 Pro 2.66T, Nemotron 3 Ultra 2.39T.

claims.citation: OpenRouter rankings top ten contains GPT-5.6 Luna (5.57T) as the only OpenAI model; no GPT-5.6 Sol entry.

claims.citation: Business Insider (Alistair Barr, Aug 14, 2026) reports TD Cowen's OpenRouter-usage-based estimates of ~10x/14x/34% for Luna and ~3x/5x/45% for Terra.

claims.text: Ramp: Sol captured more business spending than Fable 5 in July 2026.

claims.citation: OpenRouter Series B announcement (May 28, 2026) states weekly volume grew from 5T to 25T tokens over six months, 8M+ developers, on pace to process over a quadrillion tokens this year.

claims.citation: Startup Fortune (Aug 17, 2026) reports Bloomberg's >$7B agreed deal and WSJ's ~$10B talks; Business Insider (Aug 18, 2026) reports Axios's $8B figure.

claims.citation: Pandaily (Aug 17, 2026): increases range 50%-1,100%; V4-Pro peak cache-hit input rose 1,100%.

claims.text: OpenAI surpassed 1 billion active users in late July 2026.
claims.citation: CTV News (Jul 31, 2026) 'OpenAI says has more than 1 billion active users'; WSJ and TechSpot coverage dated Jul 31-Aug 3, 2026.

claims.text: Vercel AI Gateway charges no markup / no platform fee, billing provider list price.
claims.citation: Vercel AI Gateway pricing docs: 'AI Gateway charges no markup and no platform fee on tokens. You pay the provider's list price.'

claims.text: The channel-locked 50% Sol cut is a token-share play rather than a demand-curve response.
claims.citation: The fact pattern (channel-locked discount, unchanged direct-API list, OpenRouter rankings) supports the interpretation, but intent is not directly evidenced; the existing Flex tier at the same $2.50/$15 price offers an alternative mechanical explanation.
